nodes.name: Issuer type
nodes.question: Who, if anyone, creates and makes commitments regarding the token?

nodes.name: Asset function
nodes.question: What is the core economic or governance function the token serves for its holder?

nodes.name: Legal classification
nodes.question: Under which existing legal or regulatory category does the asset fall?

nodes.name: Stable-value reference type
nodes.question: Does the token purport to maintain a stable value, and if so, by referencing what?

nodes.name: Redemption mechanism
nodes.question: How does a holder convert the token back into its reference asset, and who controls that release?

nodes.name: Form of claim
nodes.question: Is the holder's right in personam or in rem, and against whom?

nodes.name: Yield source
nodes.question: From what source does the yield accrue to the holder?

nodes.name: Yield distribution mechanism
nodes.question: How is yield delivered to the holder: by balance change, redemption-rate change, price change, or a separate reward?

nodes.name: Minting mechanism
nodes.question: How are new units of the token created, and by what process?

nodes.name: Centralisation of control
nodes.question: How centralised is control over the critical resources (governance, minting, reserves, rewards, listing, ownership) of the asset?

nodes.name: Technical standard
nodes.question: On which technical token template or native implementation is the asset issued and transferred?

nodes.name: Fungibility
nodes.question: Is the crypto-asset fungible with other units of the same asset, or unique?

nodes.name: Consensus mechanism
nodes.question: How is agreement reached among DLT nodes that a transaction or block is valid?

nodes.name: Ledger access model
nodes.question: Who may participate in or read/write to the distributed ledger (permissioned vs permissionless)?

nodes.name: Ledger architecture and data structure
nodes.question: How is the ledger structured as a data object (blockchain, DAG, traditional balance ledger, polylithic/monolithic software)?

nodes.name: Custody arrangement
nodes.question: Who holds and controls the private keys or assets: a custodian or the user?

nodes.name: Wallet connectivity (hot vs cold)
nodes.question: Is the wallet's key storage connected to the internet?

nodes.name: Key control scheme
nodes.question: How is control over the private key held, shared, or recovered (single-key, multisig, MPC)?

nodes.name: Cryptographic scheme
nodes.question: Which cryptographic primitive secures the ledger or governs key access?

nodes.name: Privacy and anonymity level
nodes.question: How identifiable or privacy-protected are users and transactions (built-in or add-on privacy, anonymity-enhanced, traceable)?

nodes.name: Fee model
nodes.question: Are transaction fees optional, mandatory, or absent, and are they variable or fixed?

nodes.name: Network participant role
nodes.question: What role does a participant perform in securing or operating the network?

nodes.name: Staking and participation model
nodes.question: In what capacity does a holder stake or participate, and who operates the validator?

nodes.name: Crypto-asset service type
nodes.question: Which regulated crypto-asset service or activity is performed (custody, exchange, transfer, trading platform, advice, placing)?

nodes.name: Transaction intermediation and transfer structure
nodes.question: Does the transfer involve a service provider, or occur person-to-person or via self-hosted address?

nodes.name: Provider and party role in transaction
nodes.question: What role does a party play in a transaction (originator, beneficiary, intermediary, transmittor)?

nodes.name: VASP status and entity scope
nodes.question: Does the entity fall within the VASP or regulated-provider perimeter, and in what form?

nodes.name: Issuer regulatory and supervisory status
nodes.question: Is the issuer or provider supervised, licensed, or subject to prudential requirements?

nodes.name: Licensing jurisdiction basis
nodes.question: On what jurisdictional connection must a VASP be licensed or registered?

nodes.name: Supervisory authority type
nodes.question: Is the AML/CFT or prudential supervisor a competent authority or a self-regulatory body?

nodes.name: Illicit finance risk typology
nodes.question: Which category of illicit activity or predicate offence creates the ML/TF/PF or sanctions risk?

nodes.name: Issuer freeze and burn capability
nodes.question: Can the issuer block, freeze, seize or burn tokens at authorities' request?

nodes.name: Reserve asset quality and management
nodes.question: What must the reserve assets backing a stable-value token be, and how are they managed, audited and disclosed?

nodes.name: Prudential classification group
nodes.question: Into which prudential treatment group (1a, 1b, 2a, 2b) does the cryptoasset fall?

nodes.name: ICT incident, threat and third-party risk
nodes.question: How serious is the ICT incident or threat, and what dependency or concentration risk arises from third-party providers?

nodes.name: DeFi technology stack layer
nodes.question: Which layer of the DeFi stack does a component belong to (interface, smart contract, settlement)?

nodes.name: Money transmission and regulatory status of intermediary
nodes.question: Is the actor a money transmitter or otherwise regulated intermediary, and does an exemption apply?

nodes.name: Digital asset definition basis
nodes.question: On what basis is a digital asset defined (technology-based or function-based)?

nodes.name: Token form (coin vs token)
nodes.question: Does the asset run on its own independent chain (coin) or on an existing blockchain (token)?

nodes.name: Source of network token value
nodes.question: Is the token's value derived from the DLT system and adoption, or from an issuer's efforts?

nodes.name: TradFi analogue
nodes.question: Which traditional finance instrument does the asset most closely resemble?

nodes.name: Stablecoin cross-jurisdictional reach
nodes.question: Does the stablecoin reach multiple jurisdictions and carry systemic importance?

nodes.name: Central bank digital currency form
nodes.question: Is the digital money a direct liability of the central bank in the national unit of account?

nodes.name: Finality and settlement
nodes.question: Where and how does a transaction settle or achieve finality (on-chain, deterministic finality, off-chain platform)?

nodes.name: Interoperability and intraoperability
nodes.question: How capable is a blockchain of exchanging information with external systems or other blockchains?

nodes.name: Governance rules type
nodes.question: Who defines the rules governing the blockchain's operation: technical self-governance or regulatory rules?

nodes.name: Blockchain and DLT relationship
nodes.question: How does a blockchain relate to DLT as a category?

nodes.name: Corpus source type
nodes.question: What kind of source document (patent, literature, social media) makes up a corpus item?

nodes.name: Tokenised asset equivalence
nodes.question: Does a tokenised asset carry the same legal rights and risks as its non-tokenised form?

nodes.name: Consumer and market risk category
nodes.question: What category of harm (custody, fraud, privacy, operational) does the arrangement expose users to?

nodes.name: Customer asset safeguarding regime
nodes.question: Which federal safeguarding rule applies to intermediaries holding customer digital assets?

nodes.name: Transaction purpose
nodes.question: Is the transaction for payment, for network validation or operation, or for trading or investment?

nodes.name: DeFi control status
nodes.question: Does a DeFi arrangement have an identifiable controlling party, or is it autonomous?

nodes.name: Identity layer model
nodes.question: How are participants identified on the network (KYC/AML or pseudonymous)?

nodes.name: Key and value storage location
nodes.question: Where are value and controlling keys stored (local, external server, multiple locations)?

nodes.name: Issuance and distribution mode
nodes.question: Is the asset distributed as an end-user incentive or sold for consideration?

nodes.name: Reporting entity jurisdictional nexus
nodes.question: Is the entity a whole-entity, branch-level, or exempt reporter under the applicable jurisdiction?

nodes.name: ICT provider type
nodes.question: Is the ICT service provider external, intra-group, critical, or third-country?

nodes.name: Operational entity count
nodes.question: Do one or multiple entities perform the core network functions?

nodes.name: Mechanism of execution (smart contract)
nodes.question: How is a contract or program carried out: automatically by code on a ledger, or through human or legal intervention?

nodes.name: Wallet technology type
nodes.question: What technology form does a CVC wallet take (mobile, software or hardware)?

nodes.name: Wallet connectivity type
nodes.question: Is the wallet connected to the internet (hot) or kept offline (cold)?

nodes.name: Regulatory scope exclusion category
nodes.question: Does the crypto-asset fall outside MiCA because it is already regulated under another EU framework?

nodes.name: Ledger governance model (central vs decentralised control)
nodes.question: Is the ledger run by a central authority or governed in a decentralised fashion by participants?

nodes.name: Consensus network topology
nodes.question: How is the consensus network structured across participants?
